findings.detail: All inspected publisher/config-cache/generation/storage/key/Python-client and original lifecycle source bytes are unchanged from8f to124. Current retirement fix affects the separate poststart diagnostic exitcode read; Rust absolute-deadline changes are separate.

671.573598ms lies between current-input fingerprint return and next fingerprint entry. The enclosed code builds/reuses signed snapshot under generation lock, provisions/verifies key, validates command binding, recovers snapshot transaction, reads/verifies cache, possibly fsyncs pending/cache/generation state, encodes request, acquires/starts persistent client, sends/receives and validates ACK; one documented new-generation recovery iteration can also occur. Original records do not tell which subpath was taken or allocate its time.

Original service_restart publication observer records101 config loads on first cold compile and0 on second. The second compile still recaptures source identities and merges policies; caching does not mean zero work. Its22.518551ms instrumented compile is already outside the service push2.687293ms. No cache repair between8f and124 accounts for this.

Publication preserves old configuration metadata half of _input_fingerprint. Next run loop can observe inputs already captured by publication and force republish for any non-database/non-authority-marker path, even if verified policy fingerprint is unchanged. Captured first_admission setup shows changed_hint_count2 and ACK withdrawal before the observed compile; exact changed paths are not exported. Updating metadata wholesale would risk hiding concurrent changes and is not justified by the retained count alone.

Rust retire_state removes matching generation file but retains scope directory. Python fingerprint includes directory metadata; confirmation rejects any nonempty before!=observed before checking returned generation. Actual-filesystem proof shows empty retained directory→new generation is rejected, absent directory→same new generation admitted, stable generation admitted, changed existing generation rejected. This source distinction can force a redundant first-ACK rejection on a verified cold home. Captured service_restart before_present/unequal reaches exactly this early rejection branch, but its before row roster is not retained, so the observed before state is not independently proved empty.

Current scanner catches directory-iteration OSError and treats it as zero children. A fix cannot infer verified emptiness from directory-only tuple alone. It must preserve explicit unknown/incomplete scan refusal and retain malformed generation, live generation change, newest-generation binding, directory/path metadata and final commit fences.

Re-read of command authority after transport detects another process's concurrent control commit. Final resident checks prevent using an ACK from a different resident. Generation/cache transaction writes and fsync retain antirollback/durability semantics. These cannot be deleted solely to shorten the observed interval.

Linux publisher snapshot-materialization and client calls use existing2s limits. The fixture caller has its original400ms readiness gate. A publication completing after the caller gives up is compatible with those distinct budgets and is not itself proof of an RPC deadline-extension defect.
